name: Reparameterized Volume Sampling
definition: A differentiable volume rendering technique that computes color estimates by sampling points on a ray using the inverse of the cumulative density function (CDF), allowing gradients to back-propagate through the sampling locations with respect to the density field.
summary: Reparameterized Volume Sampling is a differentiable rendering technique that computes color estimates by sampling points on a ray using the inverse of the cumulative distribution function of the density field.
